verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a monitoring SaaS with SDKs, a CLI and a self-hosted edition, but nothing in the pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for any of them. Self-hosting, server-side data scrubbing and choosing a US or EU storage region are related privacy controls. None of them is shown to stop Sentry's own usage telemetry, so they can't be credited for this story.
